name: Temple of Literature
summary: Walk the courtyards of the Confucian temple at 58 Quoc Tu Giam. The operator and Vietnam Tourism both print a 70,000 VND daytime ticket, and they do not agree on the hours or the night price. The operator does not print a night fee. Vietnam Tourism prints 199,000 VND.
getThere: Metro Line 3, Van Mieu. The walk is check on arrival.
heroCaption: The Khue Van gate at the Temple of Literature
gettingThere: Metro Line 3 stops at Van Mieu. The walk from that station to the gate at 58 Quoc Tu Giam was not given a minute count. Check on arrival. A ride from Hoan Kiem is also check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Van Mieu station
legs.body: Metro Line 3. The walk to 58 Quoc Tu Giam is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: By car or motorbike. No published minute count. Check on arrival.

hours: Operator: 8:00–17:00 every day, and an evening programme 18:00–22:00 on Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday. Vietnam Tourism: 8:00–17:00 from November to March and 7:30–18:00 the rest of the year, Tuesday to Sunday, with a night visit 18:30–21:30.
closed: The operator prints every day. Vietnam Tourism prints Tuesday to Sunday for the daytime visit. Both stay.
admissionNote: Standard daytime ticket 70,000 VND on both the operator page and Vietnam Tourism. The operator also prints a priority ticket of 35,000 VND and free entry under 16, and says the night ticket is separate with no price printed. Vietnam Tourism prints a night tour at 199,000 VND. Do not treat 199,000 as the only night fee.
